routes.name: Gato Negro
routes.overview: Gato Negro is a newer alpine rock route on the East Face of Silver Star Mountain's sub-peak Whine Spire. This big, sustained 1,500-foot climb features impressive granite pitches with mostly solid rock, though loose sections and tricky route-finding require careful attention.

routes.name: Northeast Ridge
routes.overview: A technical rock line up the west summit's northeast aspect, reached via the Silver Star Glacier; more sustained than the standard glacier route but far less documented.
routes.approach: Same as the Silver Star Glacier route to Burgundy Col and onto the glacier (see that route for full trailhead-to-glacier detail), then trend toward the northeast side of the west summit.
